# Psalm 112 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Blessed the-man fearing YHWH; in-his-commandments he-delights greatly.

**2** Mighty in-the-land will-be his-seed; the-generation-of the-upright will-be-blessed.

**3** Wealth and-riches in-his-house, and-his-righteousness stands to-forever.

**4** Has-risen in-darkness a-light for-the-upright; gracious and-compassionate and-righteous.

**5** Good the-man showing-grace and-lending; he-sustains his-affairs with-justice.

**6** For to-forever not he-will-be-moved; for-remembrance everlasting will-be the-righteous.

**7** Of-report evil not he-will-fear; established his-heart trusting in-YHWH.

**8** Sustained his-heart, not he-will-fear, until he-looks on-his-adversaries.

**9** He-has-scattered, he-has-given to-the-poor; his-righteousness stands to-forever; his-horn will-be-exalted with-honor.

**10** The-wicked will-see and-be-vexed; his-teeth he-will-gnash and-melt-away; the-desire-of the-wicked will-perish.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **112:1-10**: Companion acrostic to Psalm 111. Where 111 describes God, 112 describes the person who mirrors God's character — the godly life reflects divine attributes.

- **112:9**: Quoted by Paul in 2 Corinthians 9:9 regarding generous giving: 'He has distributed freely; he has given to the poor.'

— EMET
